Title: RW Member Access to Interview Coach - Secure Token-Based Authentication and Activity Tracking
Description:
User Story: 

As a System Administrator,

I want secure token authentication with activity tracking,

So that users can seamlessly access Interview Coach while maintaining security and auditability.


Gherkin Format

Feature: Secure Authentication and Activity Tracking

Scenario: User accesses Interview Coach using a secure token
Given a member launches Interview Coach
When the system generates a temporary authentication token
Then the token shall contain Candidate ID, Email ID, Source Portal and Session Details
When the member accesses the Interview Coach
Then authentication shall occur automatically
And the system shall record all user activities
And store activity information for analytics and audit reporting

.................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................

Functional Details:

Token Must Include

  • Candidate ID
  • Email ID
  • Source Portal
  • Destination Portal
  • Session ID
  • Issued Date/Time
  • Expiration Date/Time

Activity Tracking

The system shall capture:

  • Link Generated
  • Link Viewed
  • Link Clicked
  • Authentication Successful
  • Interview Coach Opened
  • Session Started
  • Session Progress
  • Session Completed
  • Summary Report Generated
  • Summary Report Delivered

Data Security

  • Temporary token must be encrypted.
  • HTTPS must be enforced.
  • Data encrypted in transit and at rest.
  • Role-based access controls implemented.
  • Audit logs maintained for all user activities.
  • Token expiration configurable.
  • Personally Identifiable Information (PII) protected.
  • Unauthorized users cannot access analytics data.

Compliance

  • GDPR Compliant
  • CCPA Compliant
  • SOC 2 Security Controls
  • EEOC-Compliant Interview Content
  • Enterprise Data Retention Policies
  • Privacy Policy Disclosure for Activity Tracking

Accessibility

  • WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance
  • Screen Reader Support
  • Keyboard Navigation Support
  • Color-Independent Status Indicators
  • Accessible Error Messages
  • Responsive Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop Experience
  • Proper Heading Structure and Focus Management
